points.announce:
🍊🦧 PEEL POINTS ARE LIVE! 🦧🍊

The OrangeOrangus team keeps building new ways for the community to play together. Missions are open from today and give Peel Points (for now, points only).

📲 HOW TO START
⚠️ Send ALL commands in a PRIVATE chat with the bot, NOT in this group!
1️⃣ Tap 👉 https://t.me/{bot}?start=points
2️⃣ Press START, then send the commands below to the bot

🎯 MISSIONS
💬 Join the Troop → +10
   ▫️ send /start
📅 Daily check-in → +5 (every day, build your streak 🔥)
   ▫️ send /checkin
✍️ Post on X → +20 (once a day)
   ▫️ ① send /x @yourhandle (link your X account, once)
   ▫️ ② post on X including #OrangeOrangus or $ORANGU
   ▫️ ③ send /post <link of your post>
🤝 Invite a friend → +30 each (max 10)
   ▫️ send /invite and share your personal link: points arrive when your friend stays 24h

📋 USEFUL COMMANDS
/missions · /points · /badges · /rank · /rules

🏅 Collect badges and level up!
🦧 Peel the hype. Release the ape. 🍊

ℹ️ Peel Points are community points with no monetary value. Official news only in the pinned messages. Never trust DMs.
